title: IID factors for invariant strongly Rayleigh laws on countable groups
exact_target: For every countable group Gamma and every translation-invariant strongly Rayleigh probability law nu on ${0,1}^\Gamma $, does a Borel map from iid uniform labels to nu exist that commutes with every group translation on every label input?
